say:5:1061601004:1.text: I couldn't beat my son ever since he learned how to play Century Quest. I need to regain my honor.
say:5:1061601004:1.source_cn: 自从儿子也学会玩百物牌之后，我就一直比不过他，我得想办...
say:5:1061601004:1.male: I couldn't beat my son ever since he learned how to play Century Quest. I need to regain my honor.
say:5:1061601004:1.female: I couldn't beat my son ever since he learned how to play Century Quest. I need to regain my honor.

say:6:1061601005:1.text: You came just in time. Come play a game with me! Maybe I can learn something from you young folks.
say:6:1061601005:1.source_cn: 你来得正好，陪我玩一局吧！让我也学学你们年轻人的技巧。
say:6:1061601005:1.male: You came just in time. Come play a game with me! Maybe I can learn something from you young folks.
say:6:1061601005:1.female: You came just in time. Come play a game with me! Maybe I can learn something from you young folks.

say:1:1061602001:1.text: Ah! You need quick hands and sharp eyes for this game. No wonder young people are dominating this game.
say:1:1061602001:1.source_cn: 哎呀，还是你们年轻人玩得好，眼睛快，手也快。
say:1:1061602001:1.male: Ah! You need quick hands and sharp eyes for this game. No wonder young people are dominating this game.

say:2:1061602002:1.text: It seems I have a lot to learn... I wonder if I'll ever win a game against you.
say:2:1061602002:1.source_cn: 看来我要学的还很多……不知道什么时候才能赶上你们。
say:2:1061602002:1.male: It seems I have a lot to learn... I wonder if I'll ever win a game against you.
say:2:1061602002:1.female: It seems I have a lot to learn... I wonder if I'll ever win a game against you.

say:3:1061602003:1.text: Thanks for playing with me. Here! Take this! A token of gratitude.
say:3:1061602003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你陪我这个老大叔打牌，这些东西就送给你吧。
say:3:1061602003:1.male: Thanks for playing with me. Here! Take this! A token of gratitude.
